spec.description: Who uses the Agent Platform's agents, and how it goes for them: requests, errors, duration and response bytes per person on the routes agentgateway verifies a bearer on — the kagent controller route first, where one request is one agent turn (klaus-gateway for Slack, the Dev Portal, a CLI). The person is the `user` label the data plane's metrics policy adds from the verified JWT (agent-platform-connectivity, gateway.userMetricLabel). Tokens per person are not possible: the model calls carry no person, so the last row shows the models' tokens for every person together — total, cached input, uncached input, cache writes, output — and LLM usage has them by agent and model, with cost.

spec.title: Errors per second by person
spec.description: Non-2xx answers per person: an expired link or token shows up here as 401s for one person.

spec.expr: sum by (user) (rate(agentgateway_requests_total{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user", status!~"2.."}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Request duration by person (p95)
spec.description: The slowest turns per person. Not stacked.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, user) (rate(agentgateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Response bytes per second by person
spec.description: What the gateway streamed back per person: the agent's replies, tool output included.

spec.title: Requests, errors and time by person, over the window
spec.description: Totals for the selected time range, per person. `Time in requests` is the sum of request durations: on the controller route, the time people spent waiting on turns.

spec.expr: sum by (user) (increase(agentgateway_requests_total{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user", status!~"2.."}[$__range]))

spec.title: Requests per second by caller
spec.description: The `agent` label on these routes is the calling workload's ServiceAccount: `klaus-gateway` for the Slack, CLI and web channels, the portal's backend for the Dev Portal. Resolved by source IP against the agentgateway controller's workload store; adequate for accounting, never for authorization.

spec.title: Requests per second by route
spec.description: `route` is `<namespace>/<name>`: `…/kagent-controller` is the agents' A2A and management API, agent-manager's and model-manager's routes carry the same person label when their JWT policies are on.

spec.title: Requests by person and caller, over the window
spec.description: Who came through which door: the same person through klaus-gateway (Slack) and through the portal is two rows.

spec.expr: sum by (user, agent) (increase(agentgateway_requests_total{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Requests and errors by status
spec.description: Rates from the data plane's HTTP metrics on the selected routes. Gateway refusals and upstream failures show up as non-2xx; a gRPC error inside a turn rides a 200.

spec.title: Requests / s
spec.description: Requests per second on the selected routes, for the selected people. On the kagent controller route one request is one agent turn: klaus-gateway sends a Slack message as one `SendStreamingMessage` stream, the portal its turns the same way.

spec.title: Request duration (p50 / p95)
spec.description: All selected routes and people together.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(agentgateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(agentgateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Total tokens, selected period
spec.description: Every token the models counted in the selected time range: input, cached input, cache writes and output together. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Input tokens, uncached
spec.description: Prompt tokens the model read in full (`input`): the part of the prompt no cache served. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Cached input tokens
spec.description: Prompt tokens served from the prompt cache (`input_cache_read`), billed at the cache-read rate. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Cache write tokens
spec.description: Prompt tokens written into the prompt cache (`input_cache_write`), billed at the cache-write rate. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Output tokens
spec.description: Tokens the models generated (`output`). Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Cache read share of input
spec.description: Cached input over all input tokens (uncached, cached, written) in the selected time range. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: Tokens per second by type
spec.description: Stacked by token type: `input` (uncached prompt), `input_cache_read`, `input_cache_write`, `output`. Model calls carry no person (`user="unknown"` on the LLM listener), so this row follows the Gateway filter only: every agent's model calls through it, for every person. Per agent and per model, with cost, is on LLM usage.

spec.title: People active
spec.description: People with at least one request on the selected routes in the selected time range. Every request there carries the caller's verified identity claim (the `user` label); `unknown` is not a person and is not counted.

spec.expr: count(count by (user) (increase(agentgateway_requests_total{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user", user!="unknown"}[$__range]) > 0))

spec.title: Callers
spec.description: Distinct calling workloads (the `agent` label: the ServiceAccount the request came from). `klaus-gateway` is the Slack, CLI and web channels; the portal's backend is the Dev Portal.

spec.title: Errors / s
spec.description: Requests the gateway answered with a non-2xx status: a refused or expired token (401), a token without the identity claim (403), an unreachable controller (5xx). A gRPC error inside a turn rides a 200 and is not counted here.

spec.title: p95 request duration
spec.description: On the kagent controller route the request is the whole streamed turn, so this is how long the slowest turns take end to end.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(agentgateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{gateway=~"$gateway", route=~"$route", agent=~"$caller", user=~"$user"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Unattributed share
spec.description: Share of the requests on the selected routes that carry no person (`user="unknown"`): a route whose JWT policy is `Optional`, or a call that reached the route without a bearer. Should stay at zero on the controller route, whose policy is `Strict`.

spec.title: Requests per second by person
spec.description: Stacked; on the controller route this is turns per second per person.

spec.title: Usage by person

spec.name: gateway
spec.label: Gateway
spec.description: The agentgateway data-plane Gateway.

spec.name: route
spec.label: Route
spec.description: Routes of the Gateway whose requests carry a person: the ones behind a JWT policy. `<namespace>/<name>`; `…/kagent-controller` is the agents' API.

spec.name: caller
spec.label: Caller
spec.description: The calling workload (its ServiceAccount): `klaus-gateway` is Slack, the portal's backend is the Dev Portal.

spec.name: user
spec.label: Person
spec.description: The identity claim of the verified bearer (`email`), as the kagent controller acts on it. `All` is every person seen, never `unknown`.
